what: Read-only triage of open register rows: can code written only in this repository meet every clause, with a deployed caller under committed configuration. Nothing was built or run; each verdict is one reader's finding from the requirement, the register row, the owner-decision files and grep, and is a lead to verify rather than a fact. Wave r64 covered 44 rows; wave r66 covered 48 of 91 before a usage limit stopped it, and the 43 rows it did not reach are listed under not_reached.

rows.why: Hedged kind has no default path: owner decision 7 / ADR 0148 decision 3 hold that no composition root declares a hedge policy, so a hedged counterfactual set scores nothing. Unwound half is codable (ExposureEffect absent from backend/crates; wave1101 closure via attribution.rs ReleaseContext + FillScore), but the check needs all four kinds.

Owner ruling 2026-10-31 (wave1031-owner-rulings-2): Bigtable p99 is declared but stays unmeasured because Bigtable is not bought (decision 5, enable_bigtable=false), and refetch cadence stays off by default. Six objectives are named in qip-observability/src/data_plane.rs, but the check needs each backed by a recorded series.

Owner ruling 2026-10-31 (decision 14, ADR_THEN_IMPLEMENT, lane L3b): a distillate reaches qip-api's trained_models slot only through a two-person signed ModelPack, and the row stays PARTIAL until a deployed cell installs one. No execution node is deployed and no pack is signed; the release is a human act with the model-pack key.

Fidelity and determinism clauses are closed (qip-training tests/training.rs). The hot/warm lane clause means the edge node: model_serving.rs::model_manifest_targeted names a distillate only from a verified signed pack, and no pack or node exists before the owner's node switch (wave1101 DEPENDS, same as R12-MODEL-4024).

Code remains (DecisionOrigin not carried on the cell's report into LEARN; vertical_slice_correlation.rs has no learn-hop test; schema-lock sample omits decision). Even with it, the join runs on no shipped default path: qip-api serves mesh only with QIP_MESH_CELLS/QIP_MESH_REGIONS set (R12-RES-10127) and no execution node is deployed.

Owner ruling 2026-10-31: the byte-aware journal canary in data_infrastructure_guards.rs is code, but the row stays PARTIAL until a deployed connector and refetch desk reach an origin. deepbrain_connector is null in every tfvars (protected path) and QIP_DEEPBRAIN_REFETCH_EVERY is unset by decision, so the re-fetch clause has no committed-config caller.

Guard and socket test exist (Cell::apply_policy takes VerifiedPolicy; qip-acceptance downward_signed_path.rs; qip-edge-node tests/mesh.rs). The downward channel is off on every committed path: qip-edge-node builds MeshLink only with QIP_MESH_PEER, startup.sh.tftpl renders neither it nor QIP_FABRIC_URL, qip-api serves no mesh, and dev has execution_nodes_enabled=false. ADR 0043 defers asymmetric signing to node deploy.
